description: This source file implements timer management for automation actions, including creating, deleting, and handling timer expirations, with support for cron expressions and fast timers.

methods.name: freeTimerEntry
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a TimerEntry, including deleting the timer and JSON objects.

methods.name: freeTimerEntryFromHash
methods.description: Callback to free TimerEntry objects and their associated keys from hash map.

methods.name: timerExpiredThreadProc
methods.description: Handles timer expiration, creates notification, and cleans up the timer entry.

methods.name: getTimeFromCron
methods.description: Parses a cron expression to determine the next scheduled time.

methods.name: makeTimerActionHandler
methods.description: Creates a new timer based on parameters, supports cron and in (milliseconds) inputs.

methods.name: deleteTimerActionHandler
methods.description: Deletes an existing timer based on timer ID.

methods.name: handlePropertyChangedEvent
methods.description: Updates fastTimer flag based on property change event.

methods.name: timersMessageTargetInit
methods.description: Initializes timer management, registers actions and event listeners.

methods.name: timersMessageTargetDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up timer resources and unregisters event listeners.
